

# 1st page
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(showtext)
library(magick)

# Add Google Font
font_add_google("Alata", "alata")
font_add_google("Noto Sans", "noto_sans")
showtext_auto()

# Colors from your palette
bg_color <- "#E3EBF3" # awanokuni
accent1 <- "#375A9D" # noren
accent2 <- "#CB6874" # gochiso
text_dark <- "#323172" # gosuiro
text_light <- "#7093BF" # samue
grid_color <- "#D3D3D2" # ginhakushoku

p1 <- ggplot() +
  # Background
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = 1, ymin = 0, ymax = 1, fill = bg_color) +
  # Decorative top bar
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = 1, ymin = 0.88, ymax = 1, fill = accent1) +

  # Side accent line
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = 0,
    xmax = 0.012,
    ymin = 0.04,
    ymax = 0.88,
    fill = text_light,
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +

  # Main question
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0.08, # ← start position near left edge
    y = 0.52,
    label = "Who shows up \nat CPHI Japan 2026?",
    color = accent2,
    size = 24,
    fontface = "bold",
    family = "alata",
    hjust = 0, # left: 0, center: 0.5, right:1
    lineheight = 1
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1), expand = FALSE) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )
p1
ggsave(
  "assets/slide1_question.png",
  plot = p1,
  width = 1080,
  height = 1080,
  units = "px",
  dpi = 96,
  bg = bg_color
)

```

```{r}
plot_img <- image_read("assets/slide1_question.png")
# Step 3: Get dimensions
plot_info <- image_info(plot_img)
plot_width <- plot_info$width # 1080
plot_height <- plot_info$height # 1080

# ADD LOGO

# Step 5: Add logo
logo_img <- image_read("logos/wide/satom-wide-color.png")
logo_target_width <- round(plot_width * 0.15)
logo_img <- image_scale(logo_img, as.character(logo_target_width))

logo_info <- image_info(logo_img)
logo_width <- logo_info$width
logo_height <- logo_info$height

# Position of a logo
margin_right <- 30
margin_bottom <- 30

x_offset <- plot_width - logo_width - margin_right
y_offset <- plot_height - logo_height - margin_bottom

# Composite logo onto annotated plot
final_img <- image_composite(
  plot_img,
  logo_img,
  offset = paste0("+", x_offset, "+", y_offset)
)
print(final_img)

# Step 6: Save final image
image_write(
  final_img,
  "assets/slide1_question_logo.png",
  quality = 100
)

# Step 7: Display result
print(final_img)

```


# 2nd page

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(showtext)

font_add_google("Alata", "alata")
font_add_google("Noto Sans", "noto_sans")
showtext_auto()

text_muted <- "#323172" # gosuiro  — dark navy for contrast
panel_bg <- "#375A9D" # noren
accent_red <- "#CB6874" # gochiso
accent_grn <- "#97CEA1" # urahairo
text_white <- "#E9EAEB" # hakujiiro
border_col <- "#7093BF" # samue
bg_color <- "#E3EBF3" # awanokuni

# Data for stat boxes
stats <- data.frame(
  x = c(0.22, 0.50, 0.78),
  y = rep(0.30, 3),
  value = c("500+", "3", "30+"),
  label = c(
    "Unique\nExhibitor Entries",
    "Show\nSegments",
    "Countries\nRepresented"
  ),
  color = c(accent_red, accent_grn, text_muted)
)

p2 <- ggplot() +
  # Main background
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = 1, ymin = 0, ymax = 1, fill = bg_color) +
  # Top accent strip
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = 0,
    xmax = 1,
    ymin = 0.90,
    ymax = 1,
    fill = accent_red
  ) +
  # Bottom strip
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = 0,
    xmax = 1,
    ymin = 0,
    ymax = 0.1,
    fill = border_col
  ) +
  # Top label
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0.5,
    y = 0.945,
    label = "WHAT IS CPHI JAPAN?",
    color = "white",
    size = 16,
    fontface = "bold",
    family = "noto_sans",
    hjust = 0.5
  ) +
  # Title
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0.08,
    y = 0.78,
    label = "Asia's Premier Pharma Ingredients Trade Show",
    color = text_muted,
    size = 14,
    fontface = "bold",
    family = "alata",
    hjust = 0,
    lineheight = 1.15
  ) +
  # Divider line
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = 0.05,
    xend = 0.95,
    y = 0.7,
    yend = 0.7,
    color = border_col,
    linewidth = 0.4,
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +
  # Description text
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0.08,
    y = 0.545,
    label = "CPHI Japan brings together global suppliers of pharmaceutical ingredients, \noutsourcing services, and bio-pharma solutions — all under one roof in Tokyo.",
    color = text_muted,
    size = 9,
    family = "noto_sans",
    hjust = 0,
    lineheight = 1
  ) +
  # Stat boxes (background panels)
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = stats$x - 0.13,
    xmax = stats$x + 0.13,
    ymin = stats$y - 0.10,
    ymax = stats$y + 0.10,
    fill = panel_bg,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  # Stat values
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = stats$x,
    y = stats$y + 0.045,
    label = stats$value,
    color = stats$color,
    size = 20,
    fontface = "bold",
    family = "alata",
    hjust = 0.5
  ) +
  # Stat labels
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = stats$x,
    y = stats$y - 0.045,
    label = stats$label,
    color = text_muted,
    size = 8,
    family = "noto_sans",
    hjust = 0.5,
    lineheight = 1.2
  ) +
  # Segments strip label
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0.5,
    y = 0.135,
    label = "Ingredients  ·  Outsourcing  ·  Bio Pharma",
    color = text_muted,
    size = 9,
    family = "noto_sans",
    hjust = 0.5
  ) +

  coord_fixed(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1), expand = FALSE) +
  theme_void()

p2


ggsave(
  "assets/slide2_explanation.png",
  plot = p2,
  width = 1080,
  height = 1080,
  units = "px",
  dpi = 96,
  bg = bg_color
)
```


```{r}

logo_info <- image_info(logo_img)
logo_width <- logo_info$width

# Position of a logo

x_offset <- plot_width - logo_width - margin_right

# Composite logo onto annotated plot

print(final_img)

# Step 6: Save final image

# Step 7: Display result
print(final_img)
```
